meta.title: RITMO — find your rhythm
meta.description: Online ballroom dance lessons. Latin at your pace, with personal support from your coach.

hero.photoAlt: A couple performing a ballroom dance
hero.lead1: From your first step to confident dancing.
hero.lead2: Latin at your pace — with personal support from your coach.
hero.imageLabel: FEEL THE MUSIC. OWN THE FLOOR.

intro.line1: Choose a program, then a dance and a format.
intro.line2: Each dance is a standalone course.
intro.line3: All the dances together make a complete program.

catalog.note: Intro to Latin: 3 dances × 4 lessons = 12 lessons. Beginner: 5 dances × 4 lessons = 20 lessons. Choose a package separately for each dance.

intro-latin-1.description: Three dances. Your first introduction to Latin.

beginner-1.description: Five dances. The full spectrum of Latin.

beginner-2.description: Build a solid foundation and connect your moves.

beginner-3.description: From individual steps to expressive combinations.

beginner-4.description: Dance with flow. Add character and confidence.

salsa-essentials.description: Feel the pulse of salsa and master the basics.

approach.body: No partner or experience needed. Just a little space and a desire to move. Watch the lessons, practice and work with your coach on what matters to you.

understand.title: Understand the movement
understand.body: Four progressive lessons: foundations, technique, a combination and practice.

format.title: Find your format
format.body: Videos on their own, videos + 1 private lesson, or videos + 4 private lessons.

complete.title: Complete the program
complete.body: Finish each dance and move to the next level — at your own pace.

newsletter.body1: New courses, practice tips and updates.
newsletter.consent: I agree to receive course updates.

partner.question: Do I need a partner or previous experience?
partner.answer: Not for the introductory courses. The exercises are designed for solo practice. You just need enough space and comfortable clothes.

singleDance.question: Can I purchase just one dance?
singleDance.answer: Yes. Each dance is a separate course with 4 lessons and its own package. Complete all 3 dances to finish Intro, or all 5 for Beginner.

privateLessons.question: How do private lessons work?
privateLessons.answer: Personal and Mentorship packages include private lessons. They are scheduled with your coach on a separate booking platform, not on this site.

login.title: Your rhythm is waiting.
login.body: Enter the demo dashboard and try the learning experience.
login.fine: A demo without a password or real authentication. Do not enter sensitive information. One account per browser.

rhythm.title: Finding the rhythm
rhythm.description: Explore the character of the dance, musical counts and weight transfer. Start slowly: confidence grows from mindful movement.

basicStep.title: Basic step technique
basicStep.description: Work on posture, balance and precise footwork. Repeat each element a few times at a comfortable pace.

combination.title: Your first combination
combination.description: Connect the basic elements into a short sequence. Focus on transitions and staying in rhythm.

music.title: Practice with music
music.description: Bring it all together: movement, rhythm and your own character. Practice without music first, then add tempo.

privacy.title: Everything stays here.
privacy.body: Your email, name, courses, notes and requests are saved in this browser's localStorage. There is no real authentication, payment or form submission. The brand, programs, prices and lessons are illustrative. Photo: Unsplash.
